messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

Today, the little voice whispering inside me not to get up was the subconscious part of my brain I call Amy2001, who liked to drink way too much and dance way too much and party way too much and wore really small shirts and had zero responsibilities and slept until noon on the weekends.

output.joy: Today, the little voice whispering inside me not to get up was my fun-loving subconscious, Amy2001, who adored dancing and partying, wore the tiniest shirts, had the most carefree spirit, and reveled in sleeping until noon on weekends!
output.sadness: Today, the little voice whispering inside me not to get up was the part of my brain I call Amy2001, who once loved to drink and dance but now feels lost in her small shirts and forgotten responsibilities, sleeping until noon yet yearning for purpose.
output.fear: Today, the little voice whispering inside me not to get up was the subconscious part of my brain I call Amy2001, who liked to drink way too much and party way too much, reminding me that indulging too much can lead me down a dangerous path I dread.
output.anger: Today, the little voice whispering inside me not to get up was the part of my brain I call Amy2001, who just loves to drink too much and party too much and dance around in tiny shirts, and I’m fed up with her preventing me from being productive!
output.surprise: Today, the little voice whispering inside me not to get up was the unexpected, wild side of my brain I call Amy2001, who unexpectedly craved the thrill of drinking and dancing and wore the tiniest shirts while sleeping till noon—what a wild character!
output.disgust: Today, the little voice whispering inside me not to get up was that ridiculous subconscious part of my brain I call Amy2001, who shamelessly likes to drink too much, wear tiny shirts, and sleep until noon—what a distasteful way to live!
